title: Valid Anagram
statement: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.
hints: Count occurrences of each character in s using an array of size 26.
Decrement counts while iterating through t.

solutions.title: Sorting Characters
solutions.complexity: Time: O(n log n) | Space: O(n)

solutions.title: Fixed Array Counter

editorial.approach: Frequency counter: if strings have different lengths, return false immediately. Count character occurrences using a fixed-size frequency array of 26 integers (or a hash map). Increment for characters in string s and decrement for characters in string t. If all frequencies return to 0, the strings are anagrams.
editorial.why_optimal: Runs in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space (fixed 26-character array), beating sorting-based O(n log n) approaches.
editorial.pitfalls: Assuming ASCII-only lowercase characters without verifying constraints. Early return before validating all count bins are zero.
